body: Quarantine (StatusQuarantined) is checked once in Store.Served by reading the row's status from the database, so URL/DownloadURL and every handler built on them (recordshttp, share, imaging variants, app ServeStream) are refused even with a stale or plugin-built File value. Viewed refuses with ErrQuarantined; a quarantined file is never public (CreateFile/SetVisibility/SetStatus guards, rechecked under the row lock). SetStatus cannot leave quarantine so processing plugins cannot release a file; only PassScan/Scan do. FailScan default keeps the file quarantined (WithScanFailure purge is opt-in). Consequence: plugins that SetStatus(processing) on file.created (variants eager, ocr, pdf) fail a quarantined upload until they skip quarantined files.
title: SE-06 quarantine is a status enforced at Store.Served, Viewed and visibility, not at each handler
